The name Ayomide carries the meaning “Jehovah is my strength” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Yoruba. Parents who choose Ayomide usually hope their child will grow to embody jehovah is my strength and live with faith, good character and purpose.
